none: PAS KENT-F8F3C6: Roman. Coin. Billon antoninianus copy of Claudius II Gothicus. Obverse view.
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete, Roman, struck or hammered, copper alloy, radiate or billon antoninianus contemporary imitation or barbarous copy of Claudius II Gothicus (268-270AD) posthumous. Obverse: Crude radiate head right. Inscription: [DIV]O CL[AVDIVS]. Reverse: Eagle left - his ascent to join the Gods with head right. Inscription: [CONSECRA]TIO. Minted in Britain by provenance. Reece period 14. Die axis: 11 o'clock. The coin is slightly oval in shape, in fine condition with some wear and a dark green patina. The coin is likely to date to 270-285AD. Ref. Coins of England and the UK, Spink 2009, page 59 & 79 no. 749, Identifying Roman Coins, Richard Reece & Simon James, Seaby 1986, reprint 1994, page…
